accepted_journal.aggregate_algorithm: From the canonical journal directory: find . -type f -name '*.jsonl' -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum.

accepted_journal_certificate.claim: This tracked file is the exact sorted sha256sum listing used as the accepted journal aggregate preimage. Its list.jsonl entry supplies the hermetic manifest member digest; production additionally verifies the live canonical directory and member.

task13_audit.key_claim: The historical baseline/gate key columns are equal internally. They are not claimed to be keys produced by a clean recorded commit. The accepted journal records profiles and results, not request keys.

known_nonreproducibility.cause: The old f258 scheduler problem key omitted prover identity; f751 added it. Later machine-learning Context migration also changed clean kNN ranking before the Phase 2-complete branch point. The historical Task13 files were produced from an uncommitted state and cannot truthfully be attributed to any of these clean commits.

fixture.journal_excerpt_claim: The two-line file is an exact excerpt used only by hermetic parser and inventory tests; the golden was generated from the canonical full list.jsonl member.

generator_measurement.scope: Exact clean 788 worktree, list.APPEND and list.APPEND_ASSOC, canonical full historical TSVs and list journal member.
